newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Office sees Q4 sales gains.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Office sees Q4 sales gains.

text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corp chief executive Pete Danis said he expects further improvement in the company's same-location sales growth rate in the fourth quarter.

The company on Monday posted third-quarter net income of $11.7 million, or $0.19 per share, on revenues of $507 million. Revenues were up 53 percent versus a year ago, including a 12 percent jump in same-location sales from the year-ago quarter.

"The success of our product line extension into computer related supplies is accelerating. And several acquisitions, including our initial entry into the advertising specialties business, are expected to close in the next few weeks," he said.
Shares in the office products distributor closed unchanged at 19-5/8.
